arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا • إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translation: For indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
reflection: Relief and hope are present alongside the struggle, not just waiting at the end.

arabic: عَجَبًا لِأَمْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِ إِنَّ أَمْرَهُ كُلَّهُ خَيْرٌ
translation: How wonderful is the affair of the believer, for his entire affair is good.
reflection: Every trial faced with patient perseverance transforms into a spiritual victory.

arabic: لَيْسَ الشَّدِيدُ بِالصُّرَعَةِ، إِنَّمَا الشَّدِيدُ الَّذِي يَمْلِكُ نَفْسَهُ عِنْدَ الْغَضَبِ
translation: The strong person is not the one who overcomes people by his strength, but the strong person is the one who controls himself when angry.
reflection: True power is measured by emotional self-restraint under pressure.

arabic: الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَتَطْمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُم بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ ۗ أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
translation: Those who have believed and whose hearts are assured by the remembrance of Allah. Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts find peace.
reflection: True calm in a busy world comes from taking a moment to connect with God.

arabic: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
translation: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
reflection: Remembrance is a two-way connection—whenever you reach out to Allah, divine grace reaches back.

arabic: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
translation: Whoever treads a path seeking knowledge, Allah will make easy for him the path to Paradise.
reflection: Every sincere step taken toward learning and growth carries eternal spiritual weight.

arabic: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا
translation: Allah does not burden a soul beyond that it can bear.
reflection: You are never given a challenge without being endowed with the inner strength to overcome it.

arabic: احْفَظِ اللَّهَ يَحْفَظْكَ، احْفَظِ اللَّهَ تَجِدْهُ تُجَاهَكَ
translation: Be mindful of Allah and He will protect you. Be mindful of Allah and you will find Him in front of you.
reflection: Aligning your intentions with mindfulness creates an unshakeable sense of guidance.

arabic: وَلَا تَهِنُوا وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا وَأَنتُمُ الْأَعْلَوْنَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation: So do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are [true] believers.
reflection: Faith provides resilience against despair, turning setbacks into stepping stones.

arabic: مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ وَالَّذِي لاَ يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ مَثَلُ الْحَيِّ وَالْمَيِّتِ
translation: The example of the one who remembers his Lord in comparison to the one who does not is like that of the living and the dead.
reflection: Remembrance of God revives the heart, keeping your spirit vibrant and aware.

arabic: وَيَمْكُرُونَ وَيَمْكُرُ اللَّهُ ۖ وَاللَّهُ خَيْرُ الْمَاكِرِينَ
translation: But they plan, and Allah plans. And Allah is the best of planners.
reflection: Trust in the bigger picture; when your plans fall through, divine wisdom is steering you toward what is better.

arabic: إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
translation: Actions are judged by intentions, and every person will get what they intended.
reflection: Purity of intention turns simple everyday routines into acts of spiritual devotion.

arabic: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ ۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ
translation: And when My servants ask you concerning Me - indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me.
reflection: You are never distant from grace; a sincere whisper in prayer reaches God instantly.

arabic: التَّائِبُ مِنَ الذَّنْبِ كَمَنْ لاَ ذَنْبَ لَهُ
translation: The one who repents from sin is like one who has no sin.
reflection: Sincere repentance grants you a completely fresh start, erasing past missteps.

arabic: قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ
translation: Say, 'O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.'
reflection: No matter how far you feel you have fallen, divine mercy is always greater than your faults.

arabic: الطُّهُورُ شَطْرُ الإِيمَانِ
translation: Purity is half of faith.
reflection: Cleanliness of body, space, and mind lays the foundation for true spiritual peace.

arabic: لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
translation: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
reflection: Owning your mistakes with humility is the key to unlocking relief in difficult times.

arabic: لاَ يَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ مَنْ لاَ يَرْحَمُ النَّاسَ
translation: Allah will not show mercy to one who does not show mercy to people.
reflection: Compassion toward others invites divine mercy and warmth into your own life.

arabic: لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ
translation: If you are grateful, I will surely increase you [in favor].
reflection: Gratitude expands your blessings and shifts your mindset from scarcity to abundance.

arabic: مَا نَقَصَتْ صَدَقَةٌ مِنْ مَالٍ
translation: Charity does not decrease wealth.
reflection: Giving to others brings spiritual barakah (blessings) and enriches your soul far beyond money.

arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اسْتَعِينُوا بِالصَّبْرِ وَالصَّلَاةِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الصَّابِرِينَ
translation: O you who have believed, seek help through patience and prayer. Indeed, Allah is with the patient.
reflection: Patience and prayer are your ultimate spiritual anchors when facing life's turbulence.

arabic: وَاللَّهُ فِي عَوْنِ الْعَبْدِ مَا كَانَ الْعَبْدُ فِي عَوْنِ أَخِيهِ
translation: Allah continues to help a servant as long as the servant helps his brother.
reflection: Supporting others opens up unseen avenues of divine aid in your own life.

arabic: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا • وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ
translation: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out, and will provide for him from where he does not expect.
reflection: Mindfulness of God creates solutions in places you never thought to look.

arabic: كُنْ فِي الدُّنْيَا كَأَنَّكَ غَرِيبٌ أَوْ عَابِرُ سَبِيلٍ
translation: Be in this world as if you were a stranger or a traveler passing through.
reflection: Keep a light touch on worldly attachments; your true destination is spiritual tranquility.

arabic: وَعِبَادُ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ هَوْنًا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ الْجَاهِلُونَ قَالُوا سَلَامًا
translation: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them, they say, 'Peace.'
reflection: Humility and gentle words are the true marks of dignity and inner maturity.

arabic: تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ
translation: Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity for you.
reflection: A simple warm smile radiates positivity and counts as an act of devotion.

arabic: وَلِلَّهِ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَىٰ فَادْعُوهُ بِهَا
translation: And to Allah belong the best names, so invoke Him by them.
reflection: Calling upon God through His divine attributes brings your heart closer to His perfection.

arabic: أَحَبُّ الأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَدْوَمُهَا وَإِنْ قَلَّ
translation: The most beloved deeds to Allah are those done consistently, even if they are small.
reflection: Small daily habits build steady momentum toward lifelong spiritual growth.

arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
translation: Our Lord, give us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
reflection: Seek a balanced life that blends worldly success with eternal peace.

arabic: مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيَّ صَلاَةً وَاحِدَةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَشْرَ صَلَوَاتٍ
translation: Whoever sends blessings upon me once, Allah will send blessings upon him ten times.
reflection: Sending peace and blessings upon the Prophet invites abundant divine grace back to you.

arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
translation: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
reflection: When facing uncertainty or tough choices, asking for divine clarity illuminates the right path.

arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى صُوَرِكُمْ وَأَمْوَالِكُمْ وَلَكِنْ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَأَعْمَالِكُمْ
translation: Verily, Allah does not look at your appearance or wealth, but rather He looks at your hearts and your deeds.
reflection: True value lies in the purity of your intentions and the sincerity of your actions.

arabic: إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ
translation: The believers are only those who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts feel fear.
reflection: A healthy awe of God keeps your conscience alert and grounds your daily actions in reverence.

arabic: كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ، ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ، حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
translation: Two phrases are light on the tongue, heavy on the scales, and beloved to the Most Merciful: 'Glory be to Allah and His praise, Glory be to Allah the Greatest.'
reflection: Effortless words spoken with intent carry monumental weight on your spiritual scales.

arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ ذِكْرًا كَثِيرًا • وَسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
translation: O you who have believed, remember Allah with much remembrance and exalt Him morning and afternoon.
reflection: Anchoring your day in morning and evening remembrance keeps your heart connected amidst busy schedules.

arabic: إِنَّ مِنْ أَقْرَبِكُمْ مِنِّي مَجْلِسًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَحَاسِنَكُمْ أَخْلاَقًا
translation: Indeed, the most beloved of you to me and the closest to me on the Day of Resurrection are those with the best character.
reflection: Good character and kindness are among the highest expressions of faith.

arabic: وَاسْتَعِينُوا بِالصَّبْرِ وَالصَّلَاةِ ۚ وَإِنَّهَا لَكَبِيرَةٌ إِلَّا عَلَى الْخَاشِعِينَ
translation: And seek help through patience and prayer, and indeed, it is difficult except for the humbly submissive.
reflection: Approaching prayer with genuine humility transforms it into a source of real strength.

arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ تَمْلأُ الْمِيزَانَ
translation: 'Alhamdulillah' (Praise be to Allah) fills the scales.
reflection: Cultivating a grateful spirit fills your life and spiritual scale with peace and abundance.

arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
translation: And say, 'My Lord, increase me in knowledge.'
reflection: A continuous desire to learn and understand is one of the greatest prayers for lifelong growth.

arabic: مِنْ حُسْنِ إِسْلاَمِ الْمَرْءِ تَرْكُهُ مَا لاَ يَعْنِيهِ
translation: Part of the excellence of a person's Islam is his leaving that which does not concern him.
reflection: Focusing on what truly matters and avoiding needless distraction brings peace to your mind.

arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَلْتَنظُرْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ لِغَدٍ
translation: O you who have believed, fear Allah. And let every soul look to what it has put forth for tomorrow.
reflection: Taking a moment each day to reflect on your actions prepares your spirit for what truly lies ahead.

arabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
translation: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or remain silent.
reflection: Guarding your speech preserves your peace and shields you from unnecessary conflict.

arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
translation: And say, 'My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful.'
reflection: Seeking divine mercy with sincerity brings unshakeable comfort to a weary heart.

arabic: احْرِصْ عَلَى مَا يَنْفَعُكَ وَاسْتَعِنْ بِاللَّهِ وَلاَ تَعْجَزْ
translation: Strive for that which will benefit you, seek help from Allah, and do not give up.
reflection: Combine active effort with full trust in God to overcome any obstacle in your path.

arabic: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
translation: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, nor has He detested [you].
reflection: Even during moments of quiet struggle, you are never forgotten or abandoned.

arabic: الزُّهْدُ فِي الدُّنْيَا يُرِيحُ الْقَلْبَ وَالْبَدَنَ
translation: Detachment from worldly desires grants rest to both the heart and the body.
reflection: Letting go of materialism releases mental stress and restores bodily serenity.

arabic: اللَّهُ وَلِيُّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا يُخْرِجُهُم مِّنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ
translation: Allah is the ally of those who believe. He brings them out from darknesses into the light.
reflection: Faith lights up the darkest moments, guiding you clearly through confusion.

arabic: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
translation: Whoever travels a path in search of knowledge, Allah makes the path to Paradise easy for him.
reflection: Dedication to continuous learning elevates your spiritual rank and purposeful focus.

arabic: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ • إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى اللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
translation: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children, but only one who comes to Allah with a sound heart.
reflection: A clean, sincere, and humble heart is the ultimate asset you cultivate in this life.

arabic: نعْمَتَانِ مَغْبُونٌ فِيهِمَا كَثِيرٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ: الصِّحَّةُ وَالْفَرَاغُ
translation: There are two blessings that many people waste: health and free time.
reflection: Cherish your good health and spare time by channeling them into productive, noble pursuits.

arabic: فَإِذَا عَزَمْتَ فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُتَوَكِّلِينَ
translation: And when you have decided, then rely upon Allah. Indeed, Allah loves those who rely [upon Him].
reflection: Do your best, make your decision, and leave the outcome peacefully in God's hands.

arabic: مَنْ نَفَّسَ عَنْ مُؤْمِنٍ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ الدُّنْيَا نَفَّسَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
translation: Whoever relieves a believer's distress in this world, Allah will relieve his distress on the Day of Resurrection.
reflection: Easing someone else's burden brings ease and comfort to your own life.

arabic: مَن جَاءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُ عَشْرُ أَمْثَالِهَا
translation: Whoever comes [on the Day of Judgement] with a good deed will have ten times the like thereof [to his credit].
reflection: Every sincere effort is multiplied abundantly by divine generosity.

arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ رَفِيقٌ يُحِبُّ الرِّفْقَ وَيُعْطِي عَلَى الرِّفْقِ مَا لاَ يُعْطِي عَلَى الْعُنْفِ
translation: Indeed, Allah is Gentle and loves gentleness, and He gives for gentleness what He does not give for harshness.
reflection: Gentleness in your words and actions opens doors that force and anger never can.

arabic: وَعَسَىٰ أَن تَكْرَهُوا شَيْئًا وَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ ۖ وَعَسَىٰ أَن تُحِبُّوا شَيْئًا وَهُوَ شَرٌّ لَّكُمْ
translation: And perhaps you hate a thing and it is good for you; and perhaps you love a thing and it is bad for you.
reflection: Trust divine wisdom when things don't go your way—what seems like a loss may be a protection.

arabic: الْمُؤْمِنُ مِرْآةُ أَخِيهِ
translation: The believer is the mirror of his brother.
reflection: Surround yourself with good company that helps you reflect and grow into your best self.

arabic: إِنَّ رَحْمَتَ اللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ مِّنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation: Indeed, the mercy of Allah is near to the doers of good.
reflection: Striving for excellence in your conduct keeps you closely connected to divine grace.

arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَنْ أَصْلَحَ سَرِيرَتَهُ
translation: He has succeeded who purifies his inner self.
reflection: True spiritual success starts by tending to your heart, thoughts, and private intentions.

arabic: أَلَا إِنَّ أَوْلِيَاءَ اللَّهِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
translation: Unquestionably, [for] the allies of Allah there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
reflection: Deep trust in God lifts the heavy weight of anxiety and fear from your mind.

arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى أَجْسَادِكُمْ وَلاَ إِلَى صُوَرِكُمْ وَلَكِنْ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى قُلُوبِكُمْ
translation: Verily, Allah does not look at your bodies or your appearances, but He looks at your hearts.
reflection: Focus on developing inner sincerity rather than seeking validation for superficial things.

arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
translation: Sufficient for us is Allah, and [He is] the best Disposer of affairs.
reflection: Reciting this phrase during times of pressure instantly re-centers your trust in divine protection.

arabic: مَنْ أَحَبَّ لِقَاءَ اللَّهِ أَحَبَّ اللَّهُ لِقَاءَهُ
translation: Whoever loves the meeting with Allah, Allah loves the meeting with Him.
reflection: Living a life prepared for the hereafter brings profound inner peace to your daily existence.

arabic: وَتَزَوَّدُوا فَإِنَّ خَيْرَ الزَّادِ التَّقْوَىٰ
translation: And take provisions, but indeed, the best provision is fear of Allah [piety].
reflection: True inner wealth and protection come from consciousness of God in everything you do.

arabic: واعْلَمْ أَنَّ الأُمَّةَ لَوِ اجْتَمَعَتْ عَلَى أَنْ يَنْفَعُوكَ بِشَيْءٍ لَمْ يَنْفَعُوكَ إِلاَّ بِشَيْءٍ قَدْ كَتَبَهُ اللَّهُ لَكَ
translation: And know that if the nation were to gather together to benefit you with anything, they would not benefit you except with what Allah had already prescribed for you.
reflection: Your provision and destiny are secure; what is meant for you will never miss you.

arabic: وَابْتَغِ فِيمَا آتَاكَ اللَّهُ الدَّارَ الْآخِرَةَ ۖ وَلَا تَنسَ نَصِيبَكَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا
translation: And seek, through that which Allah has given you, the home of the Hereafter; and [yet], do not forget your share of the world.
reflection: Maintain a healthy balance between spiritual dedication and enjoying life's permissible blessings.

arabic: مَا زَادَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا بِعَفْوٍ إِلاَّ عِزًّا
translation: And Allah increases a servant in honor only through forgiveness.
reflection: Pardoning others isn't a sign of weakness; it is a profound display of strength and dignity.

arabic: اعْدِلُوا هُوَ أَقْرَبُ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ
translation: Be just; that is nearer to righteousness.
reflection: Fairness and integrity in all your dealings build character and earn divine approval.

arabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لِأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
translation: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
reflection: True community spirit flourishes when you genuinely wish the best for those around you.

arabic: وَبِالْوَالِدَيْنِ إِحْسَانًا
translation: And to parents, good treatment.
reflection: Honoring and caring for your parents is one of the most direct pathways to spiritual fulfillment.

arabic: اُطْلُبُوا الْعِلْمَ مِنَ الْمَهْدِ إِلَى اللَّحْدِ
translation: Seek knowledge from the cradle to the grave.
reflection: Curiosity and the pursuit of wisdom are lifelong commitments that keep the mind sharp.

arabic: وَيُطْعِمُونَ الطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا
translation: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive.
reflection: True generosity shines brightest when you share what you value most with those in need.

arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ أَوْحَى إِلَىَّ أَنْ تَوَاضَعُوا حَتَّى لاَ يَفْخَرَ أَحَدٌ عَلَى أَحَدٍ
translation: Verily, Allah has revealed to me that you should be humble so that no one oppresses another or boasts over another.
reflection: Humility preserves harmony in relationships and earns genuine respect from others.

arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْمَرْحَمَةِ
translation: And then being of those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.
reflection: Building a supportive community means encouraging patience and showing active compassion.

arabic: سَيِّدُ الاِسْتِغْفَارِ: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ
translation: The chief prayer for forgiveness is: 'O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no deity except You. You created me, and I am Your servant...'
reflection: Acknowledging divine lordship while admitting human shortcoming is the pinnacle of repentance.

arabic: لَّيْسَ الْبِرَّ أَن تُوَلُّوا وُجُوهَكُمْ قِبَلَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ وَلَٰكِنَّ الْبِرَّ مَنْ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ
translation: Righteousness is not that you turn your faces toward the east or the west, but true righteousness is [in] one who believes in Allah...
reflection: True faith combines sound belief with active, practical charity toward those around you.

arabic: لَوْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ تَتَوَكَّلُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ حَقَّ تَوَكُّلِهِ لَرَزَقَكُمْ كَمَا يَرْزُقُ الطَّيْرَ
translation: If you were to rely upon Allah with the reliance due to Him, He would provide for you as He provides for the birds.
reflection: Birds leave their nests empty and return full; combine earnest work with absolute reliance on God.

arabic: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَالَمِينَ
translation: And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a mercy to the worlds.
reflection: Let compassion be the driving principle behind your dealings with all living beings.

arabic: الرَّاحِمُونَ يَرْحَمُهُمُ الرَّحْمَنُ ارْحَمُوا مَنْ فِي الأَرْضِ يَرْحَمْكُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ
translation: The merciful will be shown mercy by the Most Merciful. Be merciful to those on the earth, and the One in the heavens will have mercy upon you.
reflection: Empathy and kindness extended to creation unlock the limitless mercy of the Creator.

arabic: وَاعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ الْيَقِينُ
translation: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty [death].
reflection: Spiritual growth is a lifelong journey of consistency and steadfast devotion.

arabic: وَمَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
translation: Whoever treads a path in search of knowledge, Allah will make easy for him the path to Paradise.
reflection: Every hour spent acquiring beneficial skills or sacred knowledge elevates your spiritual station.

arabic: وَأَحْسِنُوا ۛ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation: And do good; indeed, Allah loves the doers of good.
reflection: Striving for excellence in your daily efforts makes your work beloved in the eyes of God.

arabic: احْرِصْ عَلَى مَا يَنْفَعُكَ وَاسْتَعِينُوا بِاللَّهِ وَلَا تَعْجَزْ
translation: Be keen upon that which benefits you, seek help from Allah, and do not lose heart.
reflection: Energy invested in constructive goals, paired with prayer, yields lasting peace of mind.

arabic: وَالْكَاظِمِينَ الْغَيْظَ وَالْعَافِينَ عَنِ النَّاسِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation: And who restrain anger and who pardon the people - and Allah loves the doers of good.
reflection: Mastering your temper in difficult moments is a high mark of spiritual maturity.

arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى صُوَرِكُمْ وَأَمْوَالِكُمْ، وَلَكِنْ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَأَعْمَالِكُمْ
translation: Allah does not look at your appearances or your wealth, but He looks at your hearts and your actions.
reflection: Focus on purifying your intentions and refining your everyday conduct.

arabic: وَالْبَاقِيَاتُ الصَّالِحَاتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ أَمَلًا
translation: But the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for [one's] hope.
reflection: The spiritual habits and good deeds you build today carry real, eternal value.

arabic: مَا مِنْ شَيْءٍ أَثْقَلُ فِي مِيزَانِ الْمُؤْمِنِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنْ حُسْنِ الْخُلُقِ
translation: Nothing is heavier on the scale of a believer on the Day of Resurrection than good character.
reflection: Kindness, honesty, and politeness weigh heaviest when your deeds are measured.

arabic: لاَ إِكْرَاهَ فِي الدِّينِ ۖ قَد تَّبَيَّنَ الرُّشْدُ مِنَ الْغَيِّ
translation: There shall be no compulsion in religion. The right course has become clear from the wrong.
reflection: Faith is built on voluntary conviction, sincerity, and personal realization.

arabic: وَالصَّدَقَةُ بُرْهَانٌ وَالصَّبْرُ ضِيَاءٌ
translation: Charity is proof [of faith], and patience is illumination.
reflection: Patience acts as a guiding beacon through dark and confusing seasons of life.

arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوا وَّالَّذِينَ هُم مُّحْسِنُونَ
translation: Indeed, Allah is with those who fear Him and those who are doers of good.
reflection: Staying mindful of God and treating others with excellence guarantees divine company.

arabic: الْجَنَّةُ تَحْتَ أَقْدَامِ الأُمَّهَاتِ
translation: Paradise lies under the feet of mothers.
reflection: Showing devotion, gratitude, and care to your mother opens the highest doors of grace.

arabic: بَلَىٰ مَنْ أَسْلَمَ وَجْهَهُ لِلَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌ فَلَهُ أَجْرُهُ عِندَ رَبِّهِ
translation: Yes, whoever submits his face to Allah while he is a doer of good will have his reward with his Lord.
reflection: Combining sincere devotion to God with active goodness toward people ensures ultimate peace.

arabic: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ
translation: A true believer is one from whose tongue and hand others are safe.
reflection: Your character is reflected in how safely and respectfully others feel around you.

arabic: وَالَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوا فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا ۚ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَمَعَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways. And indeed, Allah is with the doers of good.
reflection: Every sincere inner effort you make to improve yourself is met with divine guidance.

arabic: أَكْمَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِيمَانًا أَحْسَنُهُمْ خُلُقًا
translation: The most complete of believers in faith are those with the best character.
reflection: Spiritual excellence is measured by kindness, patience, and good manners.

arabic: مَّثَلُ الَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَالَهُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ حَبَّةٍ أَنبَتَتْ سَبْعَ سَنَابِلَ
translation: The example of those who spend their wealth in the way of Allah is like a seed [of grain] which grows seven ears.
reflection: Acts of charity multiply blessings back into your life in unforeseen ways.

arabic: مَا نَقَصَتْ صَدَقَةٌ مِنْ مَالٍ وَمَا زَادَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا بِعَفْوٍ إِلاَّ عِزًّا
translation: Charity does not decrease wealth, and Allah increases a servant in honor only through forgiveness.
reflection: Generosity enriches your spirit, while forgiving others elevates your dignity.

arabic: وَالذَّاكِرِينَ اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَالذَّاكِرَاتِ أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةً وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
translation: And the men who remember Allah often and the women who do so - Allah has prepared for them forgiveness and a great reward.
reflection: Keeping your mind anchored in remembrance brings clarity and spiritual light.

arabic: مَنْ صَمَتَ نَجَا
translation: Whoever remains silent saves himself.
reflection: Avoiding gossip and unnecessary words protects your mental peace and relationships.

arabic: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَانصَبْ • وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَارْغَب
translation: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship]. And to your Lord direct your longing.
reflection: After completing your daily work, dedicate focused time to reflect and recharge spiritually.

arabic: أَحَبُّ الأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ سُرُورٌ تُدْخِلُهُ عَلَى مُسْلِمٍ
translation: The most beloved of deeds to Allah is bringing joy to the heart of a fellow human being.
reflection: Brightening someone's day with encouragement or kindness carries immense spiritual value.

arabic: وَاعْتَصِمُوا بِحَبْلِ اللَّهِ جَمِيعًا وَلَا تَفَرَّقُوا
translation: And hold firmly to the rope of Allah all together and do not become divided.
reflection: Unity, brotherhood, and shared faith build an unshakeable foundation for any community.

arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ إِذَا عَمِلَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَمَلاً أَنْ يُتْقِنَهُ
translation: Verily, Allah loves that when one of you does a job, he performs it with excellence.
reflection: Dedicating quality attention and craftsmanship to your work is itself a form of devotion.

arabic: وَإِذَا قُلْتُمْ فَاعْدِلُوا وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبَىٰ
translation: And when you speak, be just, even if it concerns a near relative.
reflection: Truthfulness and objective justice must guide your speech at all times, regardless of bias.

arabic: مَنْ يَكْفُلُ لِي مَا بَيْنَ لَحْيَيْهِ وَمَا بَيْنَ رِجْلَيْهِ أَكْفُلْ لَهُ الْجَنَّةَ
translation: Whoever guarantees for me what is between his jaws and what is between his legs, I will guarantee for him Paradise.
reflection: Self-control over your speech and physical desires safeguards your moral integrity.

arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَآمَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا فَأُولَٰئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ اللَّهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ حَسَنَاتٍ
translation: Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allah will replace their evil deeds with good.
reflection: Turning over a new leaf with sincere good deeds transforms past failures into spiritual strength.

arabic: لاَ يَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ مَنْ لاَ يَرْحَمُ النَّاسَ
translation: Allah will not show mercy to one who does not show mercy to humanity.
reflection: Empathy for every human being unlocks boundless mercy in your own life.

arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الصِّيَامُ كَمَا كُتِبَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ
translation: O you who have believed, decreed upon you is fasting as it was decreed upon those before you that you may become righteous.
reflection: Disciplining the body through fasting strengthens inner resolve and spiritual awareness.

arabic: الصَّلاَةُ نُورٌ وَالصَّدَقَةُ بُرْهَانٌ
translation: Prayer is light, and charity is proof.
reflection: Regular prayer illuminates your path, while acts of charity demonstrate true generosity.

arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ • الَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي صَلَاتِهِمْ خَاشِعُونَ
translation: Certainly will the believers succeed: They who are during their prayer humbly submissive.
reflection: True success comes from bringing focus, presence, and reverence to your quiet moments of prayer.

arabic: تَعَرَّفْ إِلَى اللَّهِ فِي الرَّخَاءِ يَعْرِفْكَ فِي الشِّدَّةِ
translation: Remember Allah in times of ease, and He will recognize you in times of hardship.
reflection: Maintaining a steady spiritual connection when life is smooth builds a strong shield for difficult days.

arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ ۖ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا
translation: Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden greater than we have strength to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us.
reflection: Surrendering your fears through sincere supplication brings divine comfort and ease to your heart.

arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
translation: Glory be to Allah and His praise; Glory be to Allah the Greatest.
reflection: Light on the tongue yet weighty on the scales, this dhikr cleanses the mind and elevates the spirit.

arabic: الَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ قِيَامًا وَقُعُودًا وَعَلَىٰ جُنُوبِهِمْ وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ
translation: Who remember Allah while standing or sitting or [lying] on their sides and give thought to the creation of the heavens and the earth.
reflection: Reflecting on the beauty of nature while remembering God deepens your appreciation for life.

arabic: أَحَبُّ الْكَلاَمِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَرْبَعٌ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
translation: The most beloved words to Allah are four: Subhanallah, Alhamdulillah, La ilaha illallah, and Allahu Akbar.
reflection: These four statements form the backbone of daily remembrance, keeping you grounded throughout the day.

arabic: وَاذْكُر رَّبَّكَ فِي نَفْسِكَ تَضَرُّعًا وَخِيفَةً وَدُونَ الْجَهْرِ مِنَ الْقَوْلِ بِالْغُدُوِّ وَالْآصَالِ
translation: And remember your Lord within yourself in humility and in fear without being loud in speech in the mornings and the evenings.
reflection: Quiet, heartfelt remembrance in the stillness of morning and evening nurtures deep inner calm.

arabic: أَفْضَلُ الذِّكْرِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَفْضَلُ الدُّعَاءِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
translation: The best remembrance is 'La ilaha illallah' and the best supplication is 'Alhamdulillah'.
reflection: Affirming divine unity and expressing heartfelt gratitude are the highest spiritual habits.

arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ۚ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا
translation: Indeed, Allah confers blessing upon the Prophet, and His angels ask Him to do so. O you who have believed, ask [Allah to confer] blessing upon him and ask [Allah to grant him] peace.
reflection: Sending blessings upon the Prophet connects your heart with a legacy of mercy and compassion.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ
translation: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no deity except You. You created me and I am Your servant.
reflection: Starting your day by affirming your commitment to God aligns your actions with purpose and virtue.

arabic: إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ • اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ
translation: It is You we worship and You we ask for help. Guide us to the straight path.
reflection: Asking for guidance daily keeps your life's trajectory aligned with moral clarity and balance.

arabic: لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ كَنْزٌ مِنْ كُنُوزِ الْجَنَّةِ
translation: 'La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah' (There is no power nor strength except through Allah) is a treasure from the treasures of Paradise.
reflection: Recognizing that ultimate power rests with God relieves you of anxiety and overthinking.

arabic: وَسَارِعُوا إِلَىٰ مَغْفرَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ
translation: And hasten to forgiveness from your Lord and a garden as wide as the heavens and the earth.
reflection: Always take immediate initiative when it comes to doing good and seeking spiritual renewal.

arabic: أَحَبُّ الأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَدْوَمُهَا وَإِنْ قَلَّ
translation: The most beloved of deeds to Allah are those that are most consistent, even if they are small.
reflection: Building small, unwavering daily habits creates profound long-term transformation.

arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ
translation: Our Lord, lay not upon us a burden greater than we have strength to bear.
reflection: Trust that every challenge you face comes with the hidden capacity inside you to overcome it.

arabic: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
translation: Whoever travels a path seeking knowledge, Allah will make easy for him the path to Paradise.
reflection: Lifelong curiosity and dedication to learning elevate your mind and spiritual standing.

arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُغَيِّرُ مَا بِقَوْمٍ حَتَّىٰ يُغَيِّرُوا مَا بِأَنفُسِهِمْ
translation: Indeed, Allah will not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves.
reflection: Real outward change begins with internal self-reflection, discipline, and personal effort.

arabic: احْرِصْ عَلَى مَا يَنْفَعُكَ وَاسْتَعِنْ بِاللَّهِ وَلَا تَعْجَزْ
translation: Focus on that which benefits you, seek help from Allah, and do not feel helpless.
reflection: Proactive effort paired with full reliance on God turns obstacles into opportunities.

arabic: وَعِبَادُ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ هَوْنًا
translation: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily and humbly.
reflection: Gentleness and modesty in your daily demeanor bring true grace and peace into your environment.

arabic: إِنَّ مِنْ أَقْرَبِكُمْ مِنِّي مَجْلِسًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَحَاسِنَكُمْ أَخْلاَقًا
translation: Indeed, the closest of you to me on the Day of Resurrection are those with the best character.
reflection: Refining your character and treating others with respect is the highest manifestation of faith.

arabic: لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
translation: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
reflection: Acknowledging mistakes with genuine humility unlocks divine relief during times of distress.

arabic: الطُّهُورُ شَطْرُ الإِيمَانِ
translation: Purity and cleanliness are half of faith.
reflection: Maintaining cleanliness in your surroundings, mind, and habits builds a healthy foundation for spiritual growth.

arabic: إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْوَةٌ فَأَصْلِحُوا بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُمْ
translation: The believers are but brothers, so make reconciliation between your brothers.
reflection: Promoting peace, resolving misunderstandings, and uniting people is a noble act of devotion.

arabic: لاَ يَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ مَنْ لاَ يَرْحَمُ النَّاسَ
translation: Allah will not show mercy to one who does not show mercy to people.
reflection: Showing active empathy and kindness to everyone around you attracts divine mercy into your life.

arabic: قَوْلٌ مَّعْرُوفٌ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ خَيْرٌ مِّن صَدَقَةٍ يَتْبَعُهَا أَذًى
translation: Kind words and forgiveness are better than charity followed by injury.
reflection: A kind word and patient forgiveness carry far more value than giving help with resentment.

arabic: تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ
translation: Your smile for your brother is charity for you.
reflection: Bringing warmth and a positive attitude to your everyday interactions is an act of charity.

arabic: وَمَا أَصَابَكُم مِّن مُّصِيبَةٍ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَيَعْفُو عَن كَثِيرٍ
translation: And whatever strike of misfortune befalls you - it is for what your hands have earned; but He pardons much.
reflection: Use life's trials as moments for self-reflection and growth, taking comfort in God's vast forgiveness.

arabic: مَا زَادَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا بِعَفْوٍ إِلاَّ عِزًّا
translation: Allah does not increase a servant who forgives except in honor.
reflection: Forgiving those who hurt you is not weakness; it elevates your dignity and grants inner peace.

arabic: خُذِ الْعَفْوَ وَأْمُرْ بِالْعُرْفِ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ الْجَاهِلِينَ
translation: Take to forgiveness, enjoin what is good, and turn away from the ignorant.
reflection: Focus your energy on constructive good while letting go of unproductive arguments or hostility.

arabic: التَّائِبُ مِنَ الذَّنْبِ كَمَنْ لاَ ذَنْبَ لَهُ
translation: The one who repents from sin is like one who has no sin.
reflection: Sincere repentance gives you a clean slate, removing the burden of past mistakes.

arabic: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
translation: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
reflection: Gratitude and constant remembrance anchor your heart in continuous divine presence.

arabic: كُنْ فِي الدُّنْيَا كَأَنَّكَ غَرِيبٌ أَوْ عَابِرُ سَبِيلٍ
translation: Be in this world as if you were a stranger or a traveler passing through.
reflection: Maintain a light touch on worldly attachments and focus on leaving behind a meaningful legacy.

arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اجْتَنِبُوا كَثِيرًا مِّنَ الظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعْضَ الظَّنِّ إِثْمٌ ۖ وَلَا تَجَسَّسُوا وَلَا يَغْتَب بَّعْضُكُم بَعْضًا
translation: O you who have believed, avoid much [negative] assumption, indeed, some assumption is sin. And do not spy or backbite each other.
reflection: Protecting your mind from harmful assumptions and gossiping keeps your heart clean and relationships healthy.

arabic: الزُّهْدُ فِي الدُّنْيَا يُرِيحُ الْقَلْبَ وَالْبَدَنَ
translation: Detachment from worldly greed gives rest to both the heart and the body.
reflection: Releasing excessive materialism calms mental fatigue and frees physical energy for what matters most.

arabic: وَلَا تَهِنُوا وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا وَأَنتُمُ الْأَعْلَوْنَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation: So do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are [true] believers.
reflection: Faith provides resilience against despair, turning setbacks into powerful opportunities for growth.

arabic: مِنْ حُسْنِ إِسْلاَمِ الْمَرْءِ تَرْكُهُ مَا لاَ يَعْنِيهِ
translation: Part of the excellence of a person's faith is leaving that which does not concern him.
reflection: Focusing on your own self-improvement instead of meddling in others' affairs brings profound focus and peace.

arabic: وَالصَّابِرِينَ فِي الْبَأْسَاءِ وَالضَّرَّاءِ وَحِينَ الْبَأْسِ ۗ أُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ صَدَقُوا
translation: And [they are] patient in poverty and hardship and during battle. Those are the ones who have been true.
reflection: Steadfast patience during trials is the true hallmark of integrity and sincere faith.

arabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ
translation: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him honor his guest.
reflection: Hospitality and generosity toward guests reflect high moral standards and a welcoming spirit.

arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَالْإِحْسَانِ وَإِيتَاءِ ذِي الْقُرْبَىٰ
translation: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives.
reflection: Upholding justice, pursuing excellence in behavior, and maintaining family ties form the core of a righteous life.

arabic: مَا مِنْ شَيْءٍ أَثْقَلُ فِي مِيزَانِ الْمُؤْمِنِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنْ حُسْنِ الْخُلُقِ
translation: Nothing is heavier on the believer's scale on the Day of Resurrection than good character.
reflection: Noble manners, polite speech, and genuine kindness hold the greatest spiritual weight.

arabic: إِذْ أَوَى الْفِتْيَةُ إِلَى الْكَهْفِ فَقَالُوا رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
translation: When the youths fled to the cave and said, 'Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.'
reflection: In moments of pressure, seeking divine shelter and clarity leads to safety and wisdom.

arabic: وَاللَّهُ فِي عَوْنِ الْعَبْدِ مَا كَانَ الْعَبْدُ فِي عَوْنِ أَخِيهِ
translation: Allah continues to help a servant as long as the servant helps his brother.
reflection: Extending a helping hand to others ensures that divine support remains present in your own life.
